issues.finding: A box-only GPT entrant receives pixel IoU and Dice if an accidental mask_path is present.
issues.recommendation: Reject or explicitly ignore masks for a7_gpt_sol and a8_gpt_terra before scoring.
issues.resolution: Fixed: box-only GPT mask_path rejected before scoring; regression passes.

issues.topic: Public eligibility and unscored local failures
issues.finding: Global manifest status completed is additionally required even when every public image is valid; a failure only in unscored local images can disqualify the public run.
issues.recommendation: Clarify this rule or gate ranking on public validity independently.
issues.resolution: Fixed: a partial entrant with all public samples valid remains eligible; dedicated regression passes.

issues.finding: The common input manifest binds the RGB PNG hash but not the separate RGBI raster content.
issues.recommendation: Record and validate rgbi_sha256 for enhanced-input runs.
issues.resolution: Root will provide a post-run RGBI input audit and disclose that its file hash was not in the original frozen manifest. RGB main-board hashes are unaffected.
